summary: This investigation reviewed two reconciliation exceptions for transfer TRF-1002. Exception for SEC-103 (CORPORATE_ACTION_TIMING) is fully explained by independently verified corporate action evidence (CA-2026-081), which documents a 2-for-1 split effective 2026-08-10, normalizing the delivered quantity of 40 to the expected 80. Exception for SEC-104 (QUANTITY_MISMATCH) remains unresolved: the receiving quantity is 100 versus an expected 120, with no verified evidence explaining the 20-share shortage. All cited evidence is structured and verified, but no document extraction was performed as IXP was disabled.
